scientific_integrity: The general result is proved by explicit homomorphism, modular gap-signature surjectivity, two-sided syntactic separation; finite transition enumeration for six moduli supports but does not establish infinite quantification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only the stated binary language with a contiguous forbidden 11 factor and scattered 01-count divisible by m >= 2; it does not assert corresponding results for arbitrary factors, other residues or higher scattered counts. No independent expert validation.
title: A Rees zero-matrix syntactic monoid for modular scattered pairs with forbidden adjacent ones
